# See tensors. [Think in ML.]{.hero-highlight}

<span data-language-key="see-tensors-think-in-ml"></span>

A hands-on session on reshaping, solving, convolving and factorizing tensors — written in NumPy, run on real images, video and city data.

### Step 1: Core Concepts [Required]{.step-badge}

<span data-language-key="step-1-core-concepts-required"></span>

Review vectors, matrices, and SVD in [Goodfellow Ch. 2](https://www.deeplearningbook.org/contents/linear_algebra.html) and complete the [pre-work notebooks]({{< var workshop.prereq_repo_url >}}).
:::

::: {.prerequisite-step}
### Step 2: Setup [Required, 5 mins]{.step-badge}

<span data-language-key="step-2-setup-required-5-mins"></span>

Run [Notebook 00]({{< var repo.colab_base >}}/00-setup-and-data.ipynb) in Google Colab to pre-load datasets.
:::

::: {.prerequisite-step}
### Step 3: Visual Refresher [Optional]{.step-badge .step-optional}

<span data-language-key="step-3-visual-refresher-optional"></span>

Watch 3Blue1Brown's [*Essence of linear algebra*]({{< var workshop.prereq_video_url >}}).
